goal: Stop attackers from disconnecting honest peers who share an IP address or Tor exit node
Ensure only the specific misbehaving connection is dropped when peer discouragement triggers
agreement: Support because dropping all peers on an IP no longer makes sense without address bans (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents an attacker from abusing shared IP addresses to drop honest inbound peers
Closes a denial of service risk for users receiving connections through Tor exit nodes
